research.lithic.knapping.desc: Stone breaks stone. Strike flint against a hard face and take what shatters off.
research.lithic.cordwork.desc: Twisted fibre holds where bare hands cannot. Everything after this is tied together.
research.lithic.woodcraft.desc: A tree does not give up its wood to hands. Bark first, then the trunk, then the split.
research.lithic.firecraft.desc: Dry tinder, a spindle, and patience. Fire is the difference between a night survived and a night endured.
lithic.gate.cutting: Your hands are not a blade. You need something that cuts.
lithic.gate.striking: Bare hands will not shift stone. You need something that strikes.
lithic.knapping.blade: The shards come together into an edge.
lithic.workbench.locked: You do not understand this yet: %s
lithic.rack.locked: You do not know how to dry this.
lithic.firepit.no_tinder: Nothing here will catch. You need tinder.
lithic.firepit.failed: The spindle smokes, and goes cold.
